scope: Actual160cm player dimension/contact validation. No browser automation, new assets or device/GPU claims.
actualHeightDefinition: Upright bind-pose boots-to-hair1.6m. Idle bends the rig and measures1.55203m; equipment is excluded from stature.

contact.shape: Inside the original broad range, reuse fitted world-space body capsules against the shorter upright player capsule. Supporting limbs remain solid. No full-skin CPU work in the game loop.
contact.stationaryCast: Reuse contact clearance while both actors are stationary; independently moving cast arms retain attack-volume behavior without pumping the root.

verifiedMiss.decision: Legitimate geometric miss. Do not enlarge hurtboxes or tune the distance to force every moving attack to hit.

remaining: Native r3 laboratory model/3LOD packing and same-version camera/sight/body bake are separate work; source clay geometry passes are not deployment approval.

cpuSample.scope: PC Node CPU sample of real cached49-capsule rig; no skin vertex calculation, renderer/GPU/device thermal measurement.

upperBound.note: Includes all.06m outward steps plus8 bisection steps; Y rejection usually removes most limbs. Broad and comfort limits are unchanged during the measurement.

limitations: Microbenchmark timings include the instrumented actual cached-pose helper. They are PC samples and cannot predict S23 frame cost or heating.
This excludes a forced root/bone refresh: no game root moved, so ensurePoseCurrent returned false. The main frame already owns animation sampling.
Far/hidden/cached modes use no additional pose sampling. Geometry,8K/4K textures, shadow/outline/LOD remain unchanged.
